title: A comprehensive review on the blending condition between virgin and RAP asphalt binders in hot recycled asphalt mixtures: Mechanisms, evaluation methods, and influencing factors
authors: Chengwei Xing, Mingchen Li, Liyuan Liu, Rong Lu, et al.
taskZh: 综述新旧沥青混融机理、混融度评价方法与影响因素，为再生沥青混合料中 RAP 掺量与再生剂方案的智能推荐提供机理支撑。

title: Warm mix asphalt technology: An up to date review
authors: Goshtasp Cheraghian, Augusto Cannone Falchetto, Zhanping You, Siyu Chen, et al.
taskZh: 综述各类温拌沥青技术（有机添加剂、发泡、化学添加剂）的降黏机理、流变与路用性能及环境效益，支撑温拌材料方案推荐。

title: Review on Machine Learning Techniques for Developing Pavement Performance Prediction Models
authors: Rita Justo-Silva, Adelino Ferreira, Gerardo Flintsch
taskZh: 综述用于路面性能预测的机器学习算法（回归、树模型、神经网络等）及其输入特征与精度表现，为性能预测模型选型提供依据。

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction

title: A Novel Multi-Criteria Decision-Making Model for Building Material Supplier Selection Based on Entropy-AHP Weighted TOPSIS

authors: Jianxi Yang, Xiaoxia Yang, Ren Li, Mengting Luo, et al.

taskZh: 融合知识图谱与案例推理，实现桥梁事故案例的结构化表示与相似案例检索

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering

taskZh: 提出双塔稠密向量检索器，用语义嵌入替代稀疏检索显著提升开放域问答召回率

title: Milvus: A Purpose-Built Vector Data Management System

title: The effect of mix design method on performance of asphalt mixtures containing reclaimed asphalt pavement and recycling agents: Superpave versus balanced mix design
authors: Ziari Hassan et al.
taskZh: 对含RAP与再生剂的沥青混合料分别采用Superpave体积设计法与平衡配合比设计（BMD）法，对比两种方法所得最佳沥青用量及车辙、中低温开裂等性能，说明BMD在兼顾抗车辙与抗开裂上的优势及不同交通/气候条件下的设计方法选择依据。

title: Evaluation of open-grade friction course (OGFC) mixtures with high content SBS polymer modified asphalt
authors: Jiawei Zhang, Weidong Huang, Gengren Hao, Chuanqi Yan, et al.
taskZh: 以4.5%、6.0%、7.5%、9.0%四档SBS掺量制备OGFC排水磨耗层混合料，经布氏黏度、频率扫描、肯塔堡飞散、TSR、汉堡车辙与四点弯曲试验表明：提高SBS掺量使沥青更富弹性、降低黏度温度敏感性并提高复数模量，从而提升飞散抗力、水稳定性与高温抗车辙、改善疲劳抗裂。

title: Laboratory investigation and statistical analysis of the rutting and fatigue resistance of asphalt mixtures containing crumb-rubber and wax-based warm mix asphalt additive
authors: Yazdipanah Farzad et al.
taskZh: 针对橡胶粉与蜡基温拌剂复配的沥青混合料，采用动态蠕变与间接拉伸疲劳试验评价其抗车辙与抗疲劳性能，并用统计分析方法（方差分析类）辨识橡胶粉掺量与温拌剂掺量各因素对两种性能影响的显著性排序。

title: Optimization design of rubberized porous asphalt mixture based on noise reduction and pavement performance
authors: Lei Xu, Yi Zhang, Zhenshan Zhang, Hangtian Ni, et al.
taskZh: 以交通降噪效果与路用性能为双目标，对橡胶粉多孔（排水）沥青混合料进行配合比优化设计，确定橡胶粉掺量、空隙率与级配的最优组合，在保证渗水与降噪功能的同时兼顾耐久性与力学性能，给出功能-性能平衡的推荐配比。

title: Performance evaluation of asphalt mixtures containing warm mix asphalt (WMA) additives and reclaimed asphalt pavement (RAP)
authors: Afshar Yousefi, Ali Behnood, Ata Nowruzi, Hamzeh Haghshenas
taskZh: 对比Sasobit、Kaowax、Zeolite、PAWMA四种温拌剂在0%与50%RAP掺量下的性能：54.4℃动态蠕变、5/25/40℃回弹模量、25℃间接拉伸强度、SCB断裂与TSR，结论为WMA+RAP混合料力学与耐久性能强烈依赖温拌剂类型，为50%高掺量RAP的温拌方案选型提供依据。

title: Performance evaluation of lignin-fibre reinforced asphalt mixture modified by anti-rutting agent
authors: Wu Xing et al.
taskZh: 评价木质素纤维与抗车辙剂复配改性沥青混合料的高温稳定性、低温抗裂性、水稳定性与疲劳性能，比较不同复配掺量方案相对单掺方案的性能提升幅度，给出兼顾高温与低温性能的复配掺量建议。

title: Enhancing Moisture Damage Resistance in Asphalt Concrete: The Role of Mix Variables, Hydrated Lime and Nanomaterials
authors: Noor N. Adwar, Amjad H. Albayati
taskZh: 以沥青用量与4号筛通过率为配合比变量，用消石灰按矿料质量1.5%等量替代石灰石矿粉，并掺入占沥青质量0%~6%的纳米SiO2与纳米TiO2，通过冻融劈裂强度比TSR与残留强度指标IRS量化各因素对水损害抗力的贡献与最优掺量区间。

title: Fatigue performance characterization of styrene-butadiene-styrene and crumb rubber composite modified asphalt binders with high crumb rubber contents
authors: Chenguang Shi, Wenxin Zhou, Tianling Wang, Xing Cai, et al.
taskZh: 研究高橡胶粉掺量条件下SBS与橡胶粉复合改性沥青的疲劳性能表征方法，比较不同SBS/胶粉配比组合的疲劳抗力差异并给出更优的复合改性配比方向，为高胶粉掺量改性沥青的疲劳设计提供定量依据。

title: Effects of In-Place Volumetric Properties on Field Rutting and Cracking Performance of Asphalt Pavement
authors: Weiguang Zhang, Shihui Shen, Shenghua Wu, Xiao Chen, et al.
journal: Journal of Materials in Civil Engineering
taskZh: 基于实体工程现场（in-place）实测体积参数（空隙率、矿料间隙率、沥青饱和度、压实度等）与路段车辙、开裂病害调查数据，统计分析现场体积指标对车辙与开裂性能的影响规律，为体积参数控制范围提供依据。

title: Evaluation of the Potential of Sasobit REDUX Additive to Lower Warm-Mix Asphalt Production Temperature
authors: Almeida Arminda et al.
taskZh: 在90、100、110℃三个目标击实温度下，用马歇尔试验与和易性（压实）试验评价Sasobit REDUX温拌剂，并以热拌HMA为对照：温拌混合料空隙率约4%、稳定度约11 kN、流值约4 mm、马歇尔商大于2 kN/mm，且三个温度下和易性差异小于0.4%，据此判定可降低生产温度约20℃。

title: Laboratory Performance of Hot Mix Asphalt with High Reclaimed Asphalt Pavement (RAP) and Fine Reclaimed Asphalt Pavement (FRAP) Content
authors: Sen Han, Xianpeng Cheng, Yamin Liu, Yacai Zhang
taskZh: 制备RAP掺量30%、40%、50%与细RAP（FRAP，0~5 mm）掺量10%、15%、20%的热拌再生混合料，经低温弯曲、疲劳与水稳定性试验得出：可节省新沥青41%（30-R-10）至63%（50-R-15），但低温与疲劳性能随掺量增加而下降，水稳定性呈先升后降趋势。

title: Mechanistic Fatigue Performance Evaluation of Stone Mastic Asphalt Mixtures: Effect of Asphalt Performance Grade and Elastic Recovery
authors: Jongsub Lee, Sungjin Lee, Yujoong Hwang, Ohsun Kwon, et al.
taskZh: 对6种改性沥青按AASHTO M 320与T 350的PG等级及MSCR弹性恢复分类，采用公称最大粒径10 mm的SMA级配，经AMPT动态模量与直接拉伸循环疲劳试验并基于VECD理论计算疲劳指数Sapp与容许重车等级；其中橡胶基PG76-28初始应变最小、弹性恢复最高，疲劳表现最优。

title: Predicting rutting performance of asphalt mixture from binder properties and mixture design variables
authors: Chuanqi Yan, Yuan Zhang, Hussain U. Bahia
taskZh: 采集10个州22种厂拌混合料与5种室内混合料（涵盖不同PG等级、集料、RAP掺量与配合比），将Superpave胶结料车辙因子G*/sinδ与MSCR参数Jnr3.2同混合料动态模量、汉堡车辙试验结果建立相关关系，实现由胶结料指标与配合比变量预测混合料抗车辙性能。

title: Analysis of Modulus Properties of High-Modulus Asphalt Mixture and Its New Evaluation Index of Rutting Resistance
authors: Guojing Huang, Jiupeng Zhang, Bing Hui, Hongfei Zhang, et al.
taskZh: 对比硬质沥青、聚乙烯、溶解型聚烯烃三类高模量沥青混合料（HMAM）与两种SBS改性混合料的动态模量与车辙试验，发现55℃下0.1 Hz与25 Hz动态模量之比与动稳定度相关性最好，提出以模量绝对值与该比值作为抗车辙评价指标，并判定高模量剂方案抗车辙最优。

title: Enhancing understanding of asphalt mixture dynamic modulus prediction through interpretable machine learning method
authors: Ke Zhang, Zhaohui Min, Xiatong Hao, Theunis F.P. Henning, et al.
taskZh: 对比多种机器学习模型预测E*，并用SHAP等可解释方法量化级配、沥青与体积参数的贡献，给出高精度且可解释的E*代理模型。

title: Regression-Based Performance Prediction in Asphalt Mixture Design and Input Analysis with SHAP
authors: Kemal Muhammet Erten, Remzi Gürfidan
taskZh: 用回归与集成学习预测马歇尔试件力学性能，并以SHAP量化各组成输入对性能的贡献与方向，服务于配合比设计输入筛选。

title: Coupled prediction of viscoelastic properties of asphalt mixtures using a multi-task physics-constrained neural network
authors: Bingyan Cui, Hao Wang
taskZh: 多任务物理约束神经网络一次前向同时输出动态模量与相位角，共享表征并施加黏弹一致性约束，实现耦合高精度预测。

title: BoTorch: A Framework for Efficient Monte-Carlo Bayesian Optimization
sourceRef: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33 (NeurIPS 2020), 2020
authors: Maximilian Balandat et al.
journal: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33 (NeurIPS 2020)
taskZh: 发布开源蒙特卡洛贝叶斯优化框架 BoTorch，统一提供批量、多目标、约束采集函数（含 qEHVI/qNEHVI）与自动微分优化器。

title: Sample-efficient Multi-objective Molecular Optimization with GFlowNets
authors: Yiheng Zhu, Jialu Wu, Chaowen Hu, Jiahuan Yan, et al.
journal: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36
taskZh: 用超网络条件化的GFlowNet（HN-GFN）充当多目标贝叶斯优化的采集函数优化器，一次采样即给出覆盖整个Pareto前沿的多样化候选分子。

title: Parallel Bayesian Optimization of Multiple Noisy Objectives with Expected Hypervolume Improvement

taskZh: 提出 qNEHVI，用蒙特卡洛样本近似期望超体积改进，解决多目标、带观测噪声、可批量并行下料的贝叶斯优化难题。

title: Accuracy of Dynamic Modulus Models of Asphalt Mixtures Containing Reclaimed Asphalt (RA)
authors: Majda Belhaj, Jan Valentin, Nicola Baldo
taskZh: 以0%/30%/40%/50%再生料混合料的室内试验为基准，评估Witczak sigmoid主曲线模型与广义Huet-Sayegh(2S2P1D)流变模型的E*预测精度，结论为Witczak精度最佳而2S2P1D在低频/高频段偏差较大。

title: A mix design–supporting multi-objective optimization framework for ultra-high-performance concrete balancing mechanical strength, workability, cost efficiency, and carbon emission criteria
authors: Minh Huy Nguyen, Minh Hai Nguyen, Thi Minh Truc Huynh, Phuong Nam Huynh, et al.
taskZh: 构建支持配合比设计的四目标优化框架，同时权衡抗压强度、工作性、成本效率与碳排放，输出可直接使用的配合比方案集。

title: Enhancing Asphalt Mix Design with Transfer Learning and Hybrid Artificial Intelligence
authors: Yared Bitew Kebede, Ming-Der Yang, Henok Desalegn Shiku
taskZh: 用迁移学习与混合人工智能（集成多种机器学习模型）提升沥青混合料配合比设计的性能预测精度，缓解配合比试验数据小样本问题。

title: Physics-informed TVAE and probabilistic learning for uncertainty-aware prediction of tensile strength and moisture susceptibility in sustainable asphalt mixtures
authors: Asim Abbas, Aman Kumar, Moncef L. Nehdi
taskZh: 用物理信息约束的表格变分自编码器(TVAE)扩充小样本，再以概率学习同时预测抗拉强度与水稳定性(TSR)，并输出不确定性区间而非点值。

title: Developing a prediction model for rutting depth of asphalt mixtures using gene expression programming
authors: Hamed Majidifard, Behnam Jahangiri, Punyaslok Rath, Loreto Urra Contreras, et al.
taskZh: 用基因表达式编程(GEP)直接从胶结料PG、级配、沥青用量与试验条件生成车辙深度显式预测公式，精度高且形式透明可审查。

title: Research on prediction models for low-temperature cracking characteristics of asphalt mixtures by integrating laboratory experiments and machine learning
authors: Mengmeng Zhou, Meng Guo, Xiupeng Yao, Xiuli Du
taskZh: 融合室内低温试验数据与机器学习，预测低温开裂特征指标（低温弯曲应变/劲度类），支撑低温环境下的材料选型。

title: XGBoost-SHAP framework for asphalt pavement condition evaluation
authors: Aakash Gupta, Sachin Gowda, Achyut Tiwari, Ashok Kumar Gupta
taskZh: 以XGBoost建模路面状况并耦合SHAP解释，识别主导影响因素，预测精度显著优于传统回归基线。

title: Physics-informed machine learning for asphalt mixture dynamic modulus: Balancing high accuracy with stability and rationality
authors: Jiahao Sheng, Li Liu, Zhaohui Liu, Da Yang, et al.
taskZh: 以级配、沥青PG等级、体积参数及加载频率/温度为输入预测动态模量E*，把主曲线/黏弹机理约束嵌入损失函数，提升外推稳定性与合理性。

title: Uncertainty-aware prediction of asphalt pavement roughness using probabilistic machine learning
authors: Abolfazl Afshin, Soodeh Asgari, Ali Behnood
taskZh: 用概率机器学习预测路面平整度IRI，同时给出预测区间以量化认知与数据不确定性，而非单一确定值。

title: A fast and elitist multiobjective genetic algorithm: NSGA-II

taskZh: 提出快速非支配排序与拥挤度距离的精英保留多目标遗传算法，无需指定权重即可一次性获得均匀Pareto最优解集。

title: An Evolutionary Many-Objective Optimization Algorithm Using Reference-Point-Based Nondominated Sorting Approach, Part I: Solving Problems With Box Constraints
authors: Kalyanmoy Deb, Himanshu Jain
taskZh: 提出基于参考点的非支配排序（NSGA-III），用均匀参考点维持多样性，解决4个及以上目标时Pareto解退化的问题。

title: MOEA/D: A Multiobjective Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Decomposition
authors: Qingfu Zhang, Hui Li
taskZh: 把多目标问题分解为一组单目标子问题并用邻域协同进化求解，权重向量扫描即可得到分布均匀的Pareto解集。

title: Predicting the dynamic modulus of asphalt mixture using hybridized artificial neural network and grey wolf optimizer
authors: Emadaldin Mohammadi Golafshani, Ali Behnood, Mohammad M. Karimi
taskZh: 用灰狼优化器自动搜索ANN超参数预测E*，精度显著优于传统回归与Witczak类经验模型，给出可用的元启发式-神经网络混合流程。

title: Prediction of moisture susceptibility of asphalt mixtures containing RAP materials using machine learning algorithms
authors: Abolfazl Afshin, Ali Behnood
taskZh: 输入RAP掺量、级配与体积参数，用多种机器学习算法预测水稳定性指标TSR，树类集成模型精度最高。

title: Optimization of asphalt mix design considering mixture performance, environmental impact, and life cycle cost
authors: Jiarui Wang, Runhua Zhang, Hang Zhou, Weidong Huang, et al.
taskZh: 以路用性能、环境影响与全寿命周期成本为目标，对沥青混合料配合比（材料组成）做多目标优化并给出权衡方案。

title: Modeling the rutting performance of asphalt pavements: a review

journal: Journal of Infrastructure Preservation and Resilience
taskZh: 系统综述车辙性能建模方法（经验模型、力学-经验模型到数据驱动/机器学习模型），梳理输入变量体系、精度水平与适用局限。

title: Predicting the Fatigue Life of Asphalt Concrete Using Neural Networks
authors: Jakub Houlík, Jan Valentin, Václav Nežerka
journal: Journal of Materials in Civil Engineering
taskZh: 以应变水平、沥青用量与空隙率为输入，用ANN（2隐层×200神经元、MSLE损失、四折交叉验证）预测四点弯曲疲劳寿命，全数据集R²约0.90，并给出部分依赖图。

title: Asphalt Pavement Performance Prediction Using Ensemble Learning Methods
authors: Tiago Tamagusko, Adelino Ferreira
taskZh: 用随机森林/梯度提升等树集成模型预测路面性能（平整度IRI等），配合特征重要性分析支撑养护管理决策。

title: Machine learning-based inverse design methods considering data characteristics and design space size in materials design and manufacturing: a review
authors: Junhyeong Lee, Donggeun Park, Mingyu Lee, Hugon Lee, et al.
taskZh: 按数据量与设计空间规模把机器学习逆向设计方法分为优化型、生成型与判别型三类，并给出方法选型指南与挑战梳理。

title: Physics-guided neural network for predicting asphalt mixture rutting with balanced accuracy, stability and rationality
authors: Yong Deng, Haifeng Wang, Xianming Shi
taskZh: 输入级配、沥青与体积参数，用物理引导（PINN思路）神经网络预测车辙深度，在精度、单调稳定性与外推合理性上取得平衡，优于纯数据驱动模型。

title: Evolution-guided Bayesian optimization for constrained multi-objective optimization in self-driving labs
authors: Andre K. Y. Low, Flore Mekki-Berrada, Abhishek Gupta, Aleksandr Ostudin, et al.
taskZh: 把进化算法与批量贝叶斯优化耦合，在硬约束下做多目标优化，并把该策略用于自驱动实验室的自动化材料/配方探索闭环。

title: Particle swarm optimization
authors: J. Kennedy, R. Eberhart
journal: Proceedings of ICNN'95 - International Conference on Neural Networks
taskZh: 提出粒子群优化算法，用个体最优与群体最优引导速度更新，实现连续空间全局搜索，参数少、收敛快。

title: Differentiable Expected Hypervolume Improvement for Parallel Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
sourceRef: Proceedings of the 37th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2020), 2020
authors: Samuel Daulton et al.
journal: Proceedings of the 37th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2020)
taskZh: 提出可微分的期望超体积改进 qEHVI 及其精确梯度，使多目标贝叶斯优化能一次推荐一批候选配比并高效优化采集函数。

title: Taking the Human Out of the Loop: A Review of Bayesian Optimization
authors: Bobak Shahriari, Kevin Swersky, Ziyu Wang, Ryan P. Adams, et al.
taskZh: 系统综述贝叶斯优化的概率代理模型、采集函数（EI/UCB/ES/Knowledge Gradient）与收敛理论，是黑箱昂贵函数优化的方法总纲。

title: Data-driven efficient prediction and design optimisation for high-temperature performance of asphalt mixture
authors: Jinhong Tan, Shiqi Wang, Gang Xu, Xianhua Chen
taskZh: 建立数据驱动模型预测沥青混合料高温性能（车辙类指标），并反向优化组成设计，形成“高效预测→配比寻优”闭环。

title: Bayesian Optimization for Materials Design
authors: Peter I. Frazier, Jialei Wang
taskZh: 面向材料设计的贝叶斯优化工作流：以高斯过程为代理、以采集函数指导下一组实验，在实验昂贵稀少时高效逼近最优材料配方。

title: Revised Predictive Model for Dynamic (Complex) Modulus of Asphalt Mixtures
authors: M. W. Witczak, O. A. Fonseca
journal: Transportation Research Record: Journal of the Transportation Research Board
taskZh: 提出（修正）Witczak动态模量经验预测模型：以级配、沥青黏度/复数模量与体积参数回归E*主曲线，是后续所有ML代理模型的标准对比基线。

title: 数据驱动下的沥青混合料材料组成设计方法
authors: 刘朝晖 et al. (LIU Zhaohui et al.)
taskZh: 以沥青种类、空隙率等材料组成为输入、动稳定度与动态模量等性能为输出建BP/XGBoost/RF模型并建MySQL性能库，再用SQL按性能条件反向匹配出材料组成参考值。

title: High-Resolution Texture/Friction Dataset: Characterizing Asphalt Pavements and Aggregate Mosaics at Varied Polishing Stages for Measured Friction Analysis
authors: Mendeley Data 发布者（数据集条目）
taskZh: 不同抛光阶段沥青路面与集料马赛克的高分辨率表面纹理与摩擦系数数据集，用于抗滑性能与表面功能评价。

title: Long-Term Pavement Performance (LTPP) 长期路面性能数据库
authors: Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) et al.
taskZh: 美国/加拿大2500余个沥青与水泥路面试验段的长期性能、交通、气候、结构与养护数据，用于路面性能衰变建模与养护决策。

title: Pavement Performance Data（Utah Hive 研究数据仓储）
authors: Jeremiah Adejube et al. (University of Utah)
taskZh: 11种沥青混合料低温（0至-24℃）BBR动态模量与胶结料性能、RAP掺量、体积参数数据集，含Hirsch模型对比。

title: 中国统计年鉴（国家统计局，交通运输章节：公路里程、等级公路与养护数据）
authors: 国家统计局
taskZh: 全国及分省公路总里程、等级公路构成、路网密度等年度统计，用于养护需求规模测算与区域选材决策背景数据。

title: 交通运输部政府信息公开平台（统计与公路养护相关公开数据）
authors: 中华人民共和国交通运输部
taskZh: 发布公路养护统计、交通行业发展统计公报等官方口径数据，用于中国养护规模与政策依据引用。

title: Dataset used to develop soft computing models that predict the stiffness modulus of bituminous mixtures
authors: Lee P. Leon, Hector Martin, Upaka Rathnayake, Portia Felix
taskZh: 360组沥青混合料（HMA/SMA）刚度模量数据集，含沥青黏度、沥青含量、温度、体积指标等，用于模量预测建模。

title: Factors affecting asphalt concrete permanent deformation: Experimental dataset for uniaxial repeated load test
authors: Amjad H. Albayati
taskZh: 沥青混凝土单轴重复加载永久变形（车辙）试验数据集，覆盖级配、胶结料与荷载条件，用于车辙本构与预测。

title: Concrete Compressive Strength（UCI Machine Learning Repository）
authors: I-Cheng Yeh
taskZh: 1030条混凝土抗压强度记录，8个配合比与龄期特征，是材料信息学与配合比-性能回归的经典基准数据。

title: LangChain: Building applications with LLMs through composability
authors: Harrison Chase et al. (LangChain, Inc.)
taskZh: 大模型应用编排框架，用于构建“规范-材料-案例”知识库检索问答与养护方案智能推荐的解释生成链路。

title: PyCaret: An open source, low-code machine learning library in Python
authors: Moez Ali
taskZh: 低代码AutoML库，可一键完成多模型对比、调参与部署，用于快速筛选最优沥青性能预测模型。

title: InterpretML: A Unified Framework for Machine Learning Interpretability
authors: Harsha Nori et al. (Microsoft)
taskZh: 统一可解释机器学习框架，含EBM玻璃盒模型与SHAP/LIME解释器，可与黑盒推荐模型对比以提升决策可信度。

title: Pymoo: Multi-Objective Optimization in Python
authors: Julian Blank, Kalyanmoy Deb
taskZh: 多目标进化优化框架（NSGA-II/III、MOEA/D等），用于在造价、路用性能、碳排放之间做沥青方案Pareto优选。

title: DEAP: Evolutionary Algorithms Made Easy
authors: Félix-Antoine Fortin et al.
taskZh: 进化算法框架，支持遗传算法/遗传编程与NSGA-II，用于养护方案组合优化与材料配比搜索。

title: MAPIE: A scikit-learn-compatible module for estimating prediction intervals
authors: V. Taquet et al. (MAPIE contributors)
taskZh: 符合预测(conformal prediction)与预测区间估计库，为路面性能预测与养护时机决策提供不确定性量化。

title: LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
authors: Guolin Ke et al. (Microsoft)
taskZh: 高效梯度提升框架，适合中小规模路面/材料表格数据的高精度建模与超参数调优，作为推荐系统核心回归器。

title: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations)
authors: Scott M. Lundberg et al.
taskZh: 基于Shapley值的模型可解释性工具，输出各配合比/环境特征对性能预测的贡献，支撑养护决策可解释性与方案溯源。

title: GPyTorch: Blackbox Matrix-Matrix Gaussian Process Inference with GPU Acceleration
authors: Jacob R. Gardner et al.
taskZh: GPU加速高斯过程库，用于小样本沥青性能建模与贝叶斯优化代理模型，输出带方差的预测。

title: XGBoost
authors: Tianqi Chen, Carlos Guestrin
journal: Proceedings of the 22nd ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
taskZh: 梯度提升树工具箱，用于由配合比/体积参数/气候特征回归预测模量、车辙与疲劳寿命并做特征重要性分析。

title: Optuna
authors: Takuya Akiba, Shotaro Sano, Toshihiko Yanase, Takeru Ohta, et al.
journal: Proceedings of the 25th ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery & Data Mining
taskZh: 定义-运行式超参数优化框架，支持TPE剪枝与并行调参，用于材料性能模型与推荐策略的自动寻优。
